recipe.title: Staff three simultaneous call-center queues
recipe.scenario: At 10:00, assign one available, qualified agent to each of three queues for one 30-minute interval, with no agent covering two queues. Prefer Morgan for Billing escalations to preserve handoff continuity. This example does not forecast demand, size shifts, track breaks, or model service levels.

field.description: Queue labels in order: Billing escalations, Spanish-language support, Account recovery.

field.name: agent-names
field.description: Agent names in zero-based index order: Sofia, Luis, Morgan.

field.description: Flattened queue and agent index pairs after checking training and availability: 0,0; 0,2; 1,0; 1,1; 2,1; 2,2.
